name: Gogreen for Agricultural Investment and Development Company
source: Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements summary. Filed here under the exchange code GAGR as well as GGRN: the EGX board carries both codes as separate rows for the same security (identical price, previous close, volume and turnover on the same session), and this statement was collected under GGRN only. The same figures are published under both codes so the financials panel resolves whichever code the reader opens. Issuer name on the filing: Gogreen for Agricultural Investment and Development Company.
source_note: Income summary read from the Mubasher English EGX statement page; it publishes only Gross Profit and Net Income or Loss (no revenue or cost lines), so the fuller rows stay empty.
